name: Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund
oneLiner: BENJI is the on-chain share token for Franklin Templeton's FOBXX, an SEC-registered U.S. government money market fund with a stable $1.00 NAV.
collateral: U.S. government securities, cash, and repurchase agreements held by the Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (FOBXX); '40 Act-registered money market fund custodied by JPMorgan Chase Bank with Franklin Templeton as transfer agent and Benji as the on-chain share record
pegMechanism: Single fund, multi-chain BENJI token tracking FOBXX's stable $1.00 NAV; rebasing share count records distributed yield directly on-chain; subscriptions and redemptions are gated to KYC-verified Benji wallets with USD-wire and Benji-to-USDC settlement paths

notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: BENJI is the multi-chain share token of Franklin Templeton's FOBXX money market fund. Pharos tracks the Ethereum, Stellar, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Aptos, Base, and Solana deployments; BNB Chain and Canton issuances are not yet integrated. Live reserves use a curated weekly snapshot of the official fund factsheet until an on-chain NAV oracle becomes available.
